findings.reason: without stating that the repaired linkage changes the key or how a stale entry is recognised, the node can only satisfy clause (2) by clearing the cache by hand, and its declared "revert the repair" control is not red until it does the same, so the section's own measure and control can both be reported off content the repair never produced.
findings.text: §7 clause (2) requires "the repaired build gives a joint coil-plus-passive linkage that is positive definite", but the quantity the repair changes is read out of a cache whose key does not cover it: `scripts/iter_sectioned_conductor_set/build.py` derives its entry key from the conductor columns, the polygon vertices and `[max_thickness, surface_layer_m, section_n_max]` (lines 230–239), and the coil-to-passive block that §7 names as the quadrature cause comes from the whole `linkage.npy` loaded on a cache hit (lines 241–250), which stores `np.load(matrix_path)` wholesale — so an entry already on disk at that key serves the pre-repair indefinite matrix, and the repair is invisible to any consumer including the node's own gate unless the operator knows to clear the entry is missing from the plan, as is any way of telling a pre-repair entry from a repaired one; §6 solved exactly this problem explicitly for its own change ("An entry is told apart by its contents: one without the geometry file is a pre-change entry"), and §7 states no equivalent.

rubric_items.anchors_resolve: pass — `scripts/iter_sectioned_conductor_set/build.py`, `guard_positive_definite` (`nova/circuit/linkage.py:291`)` and `load_sectioned_machine` (`nova/circuit/passive.py:1176`) resolve, and the "12 mm and 6 mm sets" of clause (2) resolve to the `MESH_KEY` surface-layer thicknesses in `scripts/iter_vessel_evolution/evolve.py` (0.012 → 1312 circuits, 0.006 → 2163) that §1 names by circuit count; the only unresolvable citations are external to this repository (power_convertor's record `averaged-plant-energy-refusal`, commit `9c654e94`), which this tree cannot check and which the plan attributes rather than asserts.
rubric_items.done_when: pass — §7 declares a measurable three-clause done-when and a real negative control ("revert the repair, and the Schur complement again has the two negative eigenvalues"), and the control reverts the mechanism the clause (2) measure rests on; its red arm is nonetheless exposed by the cache point raised under reasoning, so it is red only if the repaired entry is also discarded.
rubric_items.evidence_paths: pass — §7's artefacts land in the durable nova caches it already names by shape (`.cache/iter-passive-plasma-circuit/sectioned-conductor-set/<digest>/` for the rebuilt set, `coupled-plant/<digest>/` for the delivered entry, and the pinned `coupled-plant/28148563521d92a2198b/plant.npz` for power_convertor), not a session or node-local scratch path; its gate logs follow the repo convention the earlier §6 evidence-paths finding was declined against.
rubric_items.naming: pass — §7's symbols and comments are mechanism-named (`build.py` for the linkage build, `guard_positive_definite` for the floor) and carry no plan labels, ticket numbers or version tags.
rubric_items.reasoning: a finding — §7's repair changes the coil-to-passive linkage content while the sectioned-set entry that holds it is keyed on inputs alone, so a repaired rebuild re-reads the pre-repair matrix at the unchanged key.
rubric_items.single_goal: pass — one goal (make the joint coil-plus-passive linkage positive definite at the VS3 jackets); the attribution clause is a prerequisite of that goal, not a second deliverable.
rubric_items.wiring: pass — §7's dispatch relationship is declared (followup f-ippc-003, `data-recommends-skill="/reckon-build iter-passive-plasma-circuit §7"`), and no depends-on it needs is missing: §7's rebuild of the sectioned set runs through `scripts/iter_sectioned_conductor_set/build.py`, whose geometry write is already merged, so it depends on no pending node.
